description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller named ManufacturerController responsible for managing manufacturer entities within an e-commerce admin panel. It provides functionalities for listing, creating, editing, saving, paginating, and deleting manufacturers, including validation and image handling.

classes.name: ManufacturerController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing manufacturer entities, including CRUD operations and related utilities.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all manufacturers, sets up the menu, and returns the manufacturer list view.

methods.name: createManufacturer
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the manufacturer creation form.

methods.name: editManufacturer
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the form for editing an existing manufacturer identified by ID.

methods.name: displayManufacturer
methods.description: Internal method to prepare the manufacturer form, load existing data if editing, and set model attributes.

methods.name: saveManufacturer
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a manufacturer, including validation, image processing, and persistence.

methods.name: pageManufacturers
methods.description: Handles POST request for AJAX pagination of manufacturer list, returning JSON data.

methods.name: deleteManufacturer
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a manufacturer after validation.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper to set menu context in the model for UI navigation.
